info.name: RentCheck REST Account Settings Maintenance Reports V2 API

params.name: filters[search]
params.description: Search value among maintenance report's name, inspection label, property address, city and zip code.

params.name: filters[created_date][start]
params.description: Value to filter maintenance report creation date by a starting date.

params.name: filters[created_date][end]
params.description: Value to filter maintenance report creation date by an ending date.

params.name: filters[property_id]
params.description: Get all maintenance reports for this property.

params.name: filters[inspection_id]
params.description: Get all maintenance reports for this inspection.

params.name: filters[inspection_templates]
params.description: Get all maintenance reports for the inspection templates informed. This parameter accepts multiple ids concatenated with a `,` (comma).

params.name: options[pagination][page_size]
params.description: How many items to be returned for each page.

params.name: options[sort][sort_type]
params.description:
Sort list in ascending or descending order. Accepted
case-insensitively.

params.name: options[sort][sort_by]
params.description: Sort list by a specific property.
